# Chat options

<!-- GENERATED by tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests/Docs (ConfigReferenceRenderer.RenderByArea) from the options classes. Do not edit by hand.
     Regenerate: ARCANECORE_UPDATE_DOCS=1 dotnet test tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests --filter Docs -->

15 options. Set them in the daemon's `.conf` file or `appsettings.json`. Full reference: [configuration.md](../configuration.md). All areas: [index](README.md).

Daemon says which server reads it. Reload says whether `.reload config` applies it: `live` is applied to the running server, `restart` keeps its value until the next start, `start` is read once when the daemon starts.

## `World:Chat`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AddonChannel` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | AddonChannel (vmangos mangosd.conf.dist.in:419, mangos-classic mangosd.conf.dist.in, default 1): when off, messages in the addon language are dropped (vmangos ChatHandler.cpp HandleChatMessageOpcode "Disabled addon channel?"). |
| `AddonMuteAndFloodControl` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | ArcaneCore extension: apply the existing mute and flood gates to addon traffic before offering it to chat features. Uses the same counter, limits and staff exemption as spoken chat. Off by default: vmangos ChatHandler.cpp:165-236 explicitly exempts LANG_ADDON from both gates (verified at commit 0e3ff01e76d4758e8a7c3108b2717cc785ed56fa). |
| `ChatChannelsDbcPath` | `string` | `""` | text | World | start | Path of the developer's own 1.12.1 ChatChannels.dbc (no client data ships with the server). When set, the built-in channels (ids, flags and every locale's name pattern) come from it, as vmangos loads them (DBCStores.cpp sChatChannelsStore, GetChannelEntryFor); a file that cannot be read or is not the build 5875 layout stops the start. Empty (the default): the six transcribed 1.12.1 rows, English names only, so a non-English client's General or Trade channel is created as a custom channel. Read at start. |
| `EmotesDbcPath` | `string` | `""` | text | World | start | Path of the developer's own 1.12.1 Emotes.dbc (whether an emote is a one-shot animation or a state, vmangos Unit::HandleEmote). See `EmotesTextDbcPath`. |
| `EmotesTextDbcPath` | `string` | `""` | text | World | start | Path of the developer's own 1.12.1 EmotesText.dbc. With it (and `EmotesDbcPath`), a text emote plays its animation and an unknown one is dropped, as vmangos HandleTextEmoteOpcode does with sEmotesTextStore; without it a text emote is only announced. Both paths or neither; a file that cannot be read stops the start. Read at start. |
| `FakeMessagePreventing` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | ChatFakeMessagePreventing (vmangos mangosd.conf.dist.in:1663, World.cpp:756, vmangos default on, mangos-classic World.cpp:681 and this option default off; opt in with true): collapse every run of space, tab, bell and newline in a chat message into one space (vmangos stripLineInvisibleChars, shared/Util.cpp:134). Addon messages are not touched. |
| `FloodMessageCount` | `uint` | `10` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | ChatFlood.MessageCount (vmangos mangosd.conf.dist.in:1666, mangos-classic mangosd.conf.dist.in, default 10): how many messages inside the delay window mute the speaker; 0 disables flood control (vmangos MasterPlayer::UpdateSpeakTime, MasterPlayerChat.cpp:10). |
| `FloodMessageDelaySeconds` | `uint` | `1` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | ChatFlood.MessageDelay (vmangos mangosd.conf.dist.in:1667, default 1 second). |
| `FloodMuteSeconds` | `uint` | `10` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | ChatFlood.MuteTime (vmangos mangosd.conf.dist.in:1668, default 10 seconds). |
| `GmWhisperingTo` | `int` | `0` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | GM.WhisperingTo (vmangos mangosd.conf.dist.in:2531, World.cpp:672, Player.cpp:15132): whether a game master accepts whispers from plain players at login. 0 = no, 1 = yes. vmangos' default 2 means "the state saved at the last logout"; persisting it needs a Characters schema change that no lane has made, so 2 is not offered and the retail first-login state (0) is the default. |
| `MaxAwayMessageLength` | `int` | `1024` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | ArcaneCore hardening: the longest AFK or DND reply kept on the player (characters), which is sent to every whisperer; longer text is cut to this length at a safe boundary (never inside a link or a surrogate pair). 0 = no cap. The stock client's own limit is UNVERIFIED (not captured from a real client); the 255-character chat edit box is a belief, not a measurement. The default (1024) is chosen to sit well above it. This cap, not `MaxMessageLength`, applies to AFK and DND text. |
| `MaxMessageLength` | `int` | `1024` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | ArcaneCore hardening: the longest CMSG_MESSAGECHAT text (characters) accepted; a longer message is dropped before any gate or broadcast. 0 = no cap. Not applied to AFK and DND text (`MaxAwayMessageLength` cuts that instead). The stock client's limit is UNVERIFIED (not captured from a real client); the default (1024) assumes an edit box of about 255 characters, which is unconfirmed, and leaves a wide margin above it. |
| `StrictLinkKick` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | ChatStrictLinkChecking.Kick (vmangos mangosd.conf.dist.in:1665, default off): disconnect a player whose message fails the link check instead of just dropping it. |
| `StrictLinkSeverity` | `int` | `0` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | ChatStrictLinkChecking.Severity (vmangos mangosd.conf.dist.in:1664, World.cpp:758, vmangos default 2, mangos-classic World.cpp:683 and this option default 0; opt in with 2): 0 off, 1 only the pipe commands c/H/h/r and escaped pipes are allowed, 2 they must also come in the order c, H, h, h, r (vmangos ChatHandler::isValidChatMessage, Chat.cpp:2165-2208). vmangos' level 3 also checks every item, enchant and spell link against the DBC and item catalogs; those are not available to the chat handlers, so 3 behaves as 2. A message over 255 bytes or with a bad link is dropped. |
| `WordFilter` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | ArcaneCore extension after AscEmu Management/WordFilter.cpp: apply the world `chat_word_filter` rows (schema 47) to player chat (censor or block) and to new character and pet names. Off by default: neither retail 1.12 nor vmangos/cMaNGOS filter chat text. The rows are reloaded with `.reload chat_word_filter`. |
